paper: OmniAID: Decoupling Semantics and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild (arXiv 2511.08423)
training_set_in_paper: Two releases matter for the paper: one trained on GenImage SD v1.4 (omniaid_genimage; the academic tables) and one on the authors' Mirage-Train (omniaid_v1 = OmniAID-Mirage). The served key omniaid is the later v2 Mirage-Train release. Only official checkpoints are evaluated; the two-stage training recipe is not reproduced.
